_explanation.purpose: Story map outline organizing epics, sub-epics (features), and stories in a hierarchical structure. This is the SHAPE phase - focus on story structure, relationships, and sequence. Do NOT add domain concepts here.
_explanation.structure: epics contain sub_epics (features). Sub-epics can contain nested sub_epics OR story_groups. Story_groups organize related stories with logical connectors (and/or).
_explanation.sequential_order: Always integer (1, 2, 3, 4) - unique within parent, no decimals. Shows the sequence stories/groups must be completed in.
_explanation.connectors: Story_groups have connector ('and' or 'or', null for first). Stories within groups have connector ('and' or 'or', null for first). Shows logical relationships: 'and' = all required, 'or' = alternatives. Epics and sub_epics don't have connectors.
_explanation.domain_note: Domain concepts are added by domain behavior phase, NOT shape phase. Shape focuses only on story structure, users, and relationships.
